_comment: These schemas are designed for offline WhatsApp communication and student ID verification for the CampusKart peer-to-peer marketplace.

email.description: Unique email address (must be a valid format)

whatsappNumber.description: Primary contact number for peer-to-peer transactions

studentIdUrl.description: Cloudinary/S3 URL of the uploaded Student ID for verification

isVerified.description: Status of student verification, defaults to false

sellerId.description: Reference to the _id of the User who created the listing

title.description: Title of the item being sold

price.description: Asking price for display (actual payment is offline)

condition.description: Condition of the item (e.g., New, Like New, Good, Used)

images.description: Array of URLs for item images

status.description: Current status of the listing, defaults to available
